indications: Lidocaine Hydrochloride Injection is indicated in adult and pediatric patients for the production of local or regional anesthesia or analgesia for surgery, dental, and oral surgery procedures, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, and for obstetrical procedures. Specific concentrations and presentations of Lidocaine Hydrochloride Injection is recommended for each type of block indicated to produce local or regional anesthesia or analgesia [see Dosage and Administration (2.2)].
contraindications: See Full Prescribing Information for recommended dosages and administration information for adult and pediatric patients
warningsAndPrecautions:
Lidocaine Hydrochloride Injection, USP is clear and colorless preserved with 0.1% methylparaben and is available in the following concentrations:
                  
                     1% (10 mg/mL):
                  
                  2 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 25s (NDC 0143-9579-25)
20 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 10s (NDC 0143-9172-10)
30 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 10s (NDC 0143-9578-10)
50 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 10s (NDC 0143-9577-10)
                  
                     2% (20 mg/mL):
                  
                  2 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 25s (NDC 0143-9576-25)
20 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 10s (NDC 0143-9173-10)
50 mL Multiple-Dose Vials packaged in 10s (NDC 0143-9575-10)
                  
                     Storage: Store at 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F); [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
adverseReactions: Lidocaine Hydrochloride Injection is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to lidocaine or to any local anesthetics of the amide type or to other components of Lidocaine Hydrochloride Injection.
name: Lidocaine
